name: Last Call
description: Last Call was a modified Ginivex-class starfighter given to Asajj Ventress by Count Dooku following the theft of her previous such starfighter by Obi-Wan Kenobi on Rattatak. The creation of these personal Fanblade fighters proved exceedingly expensive for the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and Dooku was known to begrudge having to replace Ventress's vessels.
